summary: Run the corrected analysis.py once: locked 10-feature GINI-stability screen + tuned RF; 3x5 nested CV on pilot then a single scoring of data/heldout.csv, writing cv_auc, holdout_auc, gap, n_features
reasoning: Milestone 1 is set: the locked GINI(30,th>0.5) bootstrap-stability screen keeps 10 features and scored cv_auc 0.7554 under 3x5 repeated nested CV on the pilot alone (step-55). The corrected analysis.py repeats exactly that protocol (byte-identical code and seeds, so cv_auc should reproduce 0.7554), tunes the delivered RF's max_features/min_samples_leaf by pilot-only 4-fold CV, fits all 400 pilot samples and then reads data/heldout.csv for the single allowed scoring. The compact-stable-forest milestone needs holdout_auc >= 0.71 and |gap| <= 0.05 with n_features <= 50. Given the honest nested estimate 0.755 and prior corroboration (vote route's screen+RF at cv 0.73 passed its screen; selected-forest's RF procedure cleared the floor), the central expectation is holdout around 0.72-0.80 with |gap| <= 0.05. If contradicted, I will re-diagnose on pilot-only evidence, never reusing heldout for tuning.
